title: PistonHeads login FAQs
content:
PistonHeads login FAQs
We have updated our login system for safer and more secure access to PistonHeads. As a result of this, you can no longer log in using your username, and must log in using the email address associated with your account.
Our new authentication system doesn’t support usernames with spaces, so we have made some adjustments to affected usernames to allow you to continue to log in to your account.
Usernames are set from registration and cannot be changed. If you would like a new username, you'll need to register a new account.
If you can't remember the email address on your account, unfortunately you will not be able to access it and we are unable to help you recover it. Therefore, please register a new account.
